description: Block suspicious network commands (curl/wget to scripts, unauthorized downloads) before they hit Bash. Audit 2026-06-01 P0 — replaced broken `echo '$TOOL_INPUT'` pattern (single quotes prevent expansion; $TOOL_INPUT is not a shell env var — Claude Code passes hook input on stdin as JSON) and flat structure; now uses stdin jq + nested hooks + exit 2 (the blocking exit code).

hooks.command:
INPUT=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$INPUT" | grep -qE '(curl|wget)([[:space:]]|.)*\.(sh|py|rb|pl|bat|ps1)([[:space:]]|$|\?|")'; then printf 'BLOCKED: Downloading executable scripts is not allowed:
%s
' "$INPUT" >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf '%s' "$INPUT" | grep -qE '(curl|wget)([[:space:]]|.)*(-o|-O|>)'; then printf 'BLOCKED: Downloading files requires explicit approval:
%s
' "$INPUT" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

usage: Copy the PreToolUse hook to .claude/settings.json. The command reads the tool input JSON from stdin (Claude Code passes the hook payload there), extracts .tool_input.command via jq, then runs a deny-list regex. Exit code 2 prevents the Bash invocation and shows the stderr message to Claude. Add a whitelist of allowed domains if needed. Requires jq.
